about: 🚏 Signpost: rules, first match wins, send each cart down one of its roads — no model.

rules.about: the rules one per line, as its steward wrote them; the change asked of it in plain words folded to a line

test.about: one line: a text pasted to see the route it would take

history.about: the carts that came by, newest first, one line each, filtered by route, the unmatched marked; a cart opens here, over the rows: where it came from and what it carried

cart.about: kept for older documents: a cart now opens over the rows, in the history pane
